title: FBI-UAP-D004, FD-1057-02, Northeastern United States, 2024
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-1057 form documenting an interview with a civilian witness regarding repeated UAP sightings near their residence in the northeastern United States.

incidents.summary: Repeated observations of plasma orbs near a residence in the northeastern United States.
incidents.quote: repeated observations of UxS or UAP plasma orbs near residence

incidents.summary: Initial observation of anomalous lights appearing as orbs.
incidents.quote: anomalous lights appearing to be orbs dating back to first observation in the early morning hours of November 2021
